clips.title: The story
paras: Orendil's Cure is a medicinal draught concocted by the herbalist Orendil Broadleaf in northern Ashenvale. Created using the rare herb Bathran's Hair, it is meant to treat the mysterious, deathly sickness afflicting Relara Whitemoon in Astranaar.

When young Relara Whitemoon fell deathly ill in Astranaar, conventional remedies proved useless against her ailment. Her desperate father, Pelturas Whitemoon, turned to Orendil Broadleaf, a hermit and master of natural medicine dwelling along the northern reaches of Ashenvale. Utilizing bundles of the rare plant Bathran's Hair harvested from the haunted ruins of Bathran's Haunt, Orendil brewed this tailored concoction. The arrival of the vial gives Pelturas hope where before he had little, though the cure only slows the disease, and Pelturas must turn to the further remedies Orendil suggested.
